Meta.title: Aleksandra Seredkina — Application Security Engineer
Meta.description: Application Security Engineer and web & API penetration tester with 4+ years of software engineering. DevSecOps, secure code review, OWASP Top 10. TryHackMe top 2%.

Hero.lede: 4+ years of building production software — now I break it so it stays unbroken. I understand the code and the architecture, not just the exploits.
Hero.characterAlt: Anime-style illustration of Aleksandra with short red hair, arms crossed

Stack.title: Tools I break and build with
Stack.description: From the browser to the pipeline: I attack applications with the same stack I used to ship them.

dvg.summary: Frontend and application security for industrial MES and Pick-to-Light systems used on warehouse and production floors.
highlights: Shipped the real-time frontend: WebSocket-driven Pick-to-Light and an interactive warehouse map.
Built the DevSecOps pipeline in GitLab CI/CD: SAST with Semgrep, SCA and secret detection on every merge request.
Audit web apps and APIs before release — IDOR, broken authentication, XSS, CSRF.
Run security design reviews and coach developers on secure coding.
Hardened infrastructure: rate limiting, security headers, Nginx and UFW, SSH policies, 2FA and access audits.

Ctf.title: Capture the Flag
Ctf.description: Competitions where I pressure-test my skills against the clock.

avito.summary: 30-hour online marathon of real-world challenges: web & API logic bugs, Linux privilege escalation, code analysis and forensics.

alfa.summary: One of the largest security competitions in Russia, with nearly 5,000 participants.
alfa.result: Security League · team in the top 20% of 513

aclabs.summary: Week-long international open CTF: crypto & stego, forensics, OSINT & GEOINT, Linux & web.

tctf.summary: My first serious CTF: 36 hours non-stop, 50 tasks across web, infrastructure, crypto and reverse engineering, 6,433 teams. Played solo.

faust.summary: Eight-hour international attack-defense CTF: keep our own vulnbox services alive while exploiting and patching the same services on every other team.
